name: WaterBridge Infrastructure LLC Class A Shares Representing Limited Liability Company Interests
summary: WaterBridge Infrastructure is a specialist in managing water resources, primarily serving companies involved in upstream oil and gas exploration and production. The firm operates a robust network of water infrastructure, with its primary footprint in the Delaware Basin, alongside further facilities in the Eagle Ford and Arkoma shale plays. Its core business involves the complete lifecycle management of produced water, including its gathering, transport, reclamation, and disposal, all engineered to support the efficient functioning of the energy sector.
